hebrewText: וַ/אֲרָם֙ יָצְא֣וּ גְדוּדִ֔ים וַ/יִּשְׁבּ֛וּ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נַעֲרָ֣ה קְטַנָּ֑ה וַ/תְּהִ֕י לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֵ֥שֶׁת נַעֲמָֽן

tokens.bdb: Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants; also the name of the son of Shem, a grandson of Nahor, and of an Israelite
to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
